Title: Admins may not be receiving new Microsoft Copilot low latency adoption reports from the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins may not be receiving new Microsoft Copilot low latency adoption reports from the Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: This may impact new Microsoft Copilot low latency adoption reports from Monday, November 9, 2026, onward.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Copilot low latency adoption reports from the Microsoft 365 admin center and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Admins may not be receiving new Microsoft Copilot low latency adoption reports from the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins may not be receiving new Microsoft Copilot low latency adoption reports from the Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: This may impact new Microsoft Copilot low latency adoption reports from Monday, November 9, 2026, onward.

Current status: We've identified that a backend data interface dependency is blocking the pipeline that provides the Microsoft Copilot low latency adoption report data to the Microsoft 365 admin center, resulting in impact. We're considering our options to correct this issue, and we'll provide more details on our fix once we've reached a conclusion.

Scope of impact: Any admin expecting to receive new Microsoft Copilot low latency adoption reports from Monday, November 9, 2026, and onward may be impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Root cause: A backend data interface dependency is blocking the pipeline that provides the Microsoft Copilot low latency adoption report data to the Microsoft 365 admin center, resulting in impact. 

Next update by: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC
